baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 1-4: kull, ummah, ja'alna, and mansakan.
baseline_models.mechanism: The making places each gathered community into a distinct ritual condition. Mansak joins an enacted station to a repeatedly followed way, so the clause installs a community-specific channel of approach rather than naming only an isolated slaughter.

activation_trace.role: A group gathered by a common matter supplies the social bearer of the rite.
A followed religion or way lets the community also carry a patterned mode of life.
Making something enter a condition supplies the deliberate appointment of a ritual form.
A place and performance of devotion make mansak an enacted station.
Persistence on a way makes that station a repeatable practice rather than a moment.

changed_reading.after: Each community is installed in a distinct, repeatable ritual route and station through which its devotion is enacted.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 5-18 link vocal remembrance and the divine name to allotted livestock, one deity, and surrender to Him.
baseline_models.mechanism: Spoken designation makes the source of an allotted benefit public, while surrender can picture handing over control. The animal is therefore not treated as autonomous possession: the rite reattributes a received living gift to its one giver and repositions the recipient under that giver.

activation_trace.role: Mention flowing on the tongue supplies the rite's audible public act.
A name as designation makes the giver explicitly identifiable.
A measured share or benefit frames the livestock as received allotment rather than self-originating property.
The sacrificial animal supplies the concrete point at which gift and approach meet.
Handing something over and relinquishing it supplies surrender's transfer of control.

changed_reading.before: People say God's name before using livestock and then obey Him.
changed_reading.after: The rite publicly reattributes an allotted living gift to its one giver, and surrender completes the movement from receiving to relinquishing control.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 19-20 direct the announcement to the mukhbitin.
baseline_models.mechanism: The addressees are pictured as broad low ground and, through the split mapping, as a flame gone quiet. The glad announcement reaches people whose receptivity is lowered, spacious, and de-escalated rather than people merely assigned a low social rank.

activation_trace.role: A broad, low, sparsely grown tract supplies a spatial image of receptive groundedness.
A fire becoming still supplies an affective image of reactive heat subsiding.
News that opens the face with joy supplies the promised response to that receptivity.
A first visible sign lets the announcement function as an onset rather than a completed reward.

changed_reading.before: Give good news to humble believers.
changed_reading.after: Announce the first opening of good to people made spacious and stable by lowering themselves and quieting reactive heat.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated naming-over-provision sequence immediately opens the animal into eating and feeding the needy, while the later material contrast denies that flesh or blood is transferred to God. The rite redirects a received allotment horizontally into shared benefit and vertically into inward guarding.

activation_trace.role: An allotted benefit anchors the focus gift whose movement is being revised.
Benefit opposed to harm frames the pilgrimage scene as practical gain, not bare ceremony.
An edible share turns the offered animal back into distributed provision.
Feeding another supplies the outward transfer that completes circulation.
Material need identifies the recipient at whom the provision circuit is directed.
Attainment distinguishes what does not arrive from the inward quality that does.
Placing oneself under protection supplies the inward yield that reaches beyond animal matter.

structural_cues: 22:28 repeats the focus sequence of naming, provision, and livestock, then commands eating and feeding the poor.
22:36 repeats naming over the animals and feeding two recipient types; 22:37 contrasts flesh and blood with taqwa.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repetition, redistribution commands, and a material-versus-taqwa contrast; I supply the arrow that divine attribution opens the resource into social circulation while guarding is its upward yield. A live alternative is that feeding is an adjacent consequence rather than part of the rite's internal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Naming identifies the giver of a sacrificial animal.
changed_reading.after: Naming converts received livestock into a two-direction circuit: edible benefit moves toward people in need, while guarded orientation rather than animal matter is what reaches God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The low-ground image becomes a sequence inside the heart: recognition of stable truth lowers it, remembrance makes it tremble, endurance prevents reversal, worship is maintained, and received provision exits as expenditure. Ikhbat is therefore responsive stability, not inert meekness.

activation_trace.role: Broad low ground anchors the focus image whose internal dynamics the context reveals.
Fear consciously felt by the heart makes lowered receptivity responsive rather than numb.
Holding the self back from panic supplies stability under what befalls it.
Wealth going out in expenditure makes the inward state materially generous.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the cognitive entry into the heart's lowering.
Reality stably matching what is so supplies the object that reorients the heart.
The contextual verb explicitly relocates low-ground imagery into the believing heart.
The heart supplies the inner site in which ikhbat takes place.
Gentle indication toward a true road turns lowered receptivity into directed movement.

structural_cues: 22:35 directly expands the mukhbitin into trembling hearts, patience, maintained prayer, and spending from provision.
22:54 sequences knowledge, recognized truth, faith, the heart's ikhbat, and guidance to a straight path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two explicit behavioral and cognitive sequences around ikhbat; I supply the causal arrow that lowering stabilizes tremor into endurance, worship, and generosity. A live alternative is that the listed acts are independent identifiers rather than effects of one heart mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The mukhbitin possess a low, quiet disposition.
changed_reading.after: The mukhbit heart is reconfigured by recognized truth: it trembles without overturning, persists in worship, releases provision, and becomes gently guidable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact appointment formula returns with practitioners of each mansak, then moves immediately from potential tug-of-war to a call toward the Lord and a straight guidance. Distinct ritual forms can coexist under the focus ayah's single deity; unity governs orientation and dispute rather than flattening every form.

activation_trace.role: A community gathered by a common matter anchors differentiated social bearers.
Divine oneness without partner supplies the common orientation across differing rites.
Continued practice on a way links an appointed mansak to people actively carrying it.
Mutual pulling between two sides supplies the social danger produced by ritual contest.
A spoken call that inclines its hearer redirects contest toward the Lord.
Gentle direction to the road supplies the common criterion beneath ritual difference.

structural_cues: 22:67 repeats the focus opening almost verbatim and adds that each group practices its mansak.
The repeated formula is followed by a bar on dispute, a call to the Lord, and straight guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies differentiated appointments, practitioners, dispute, call, and guidance; I supply the arrow that one deity regulates plural forms through common orientation rather than ritual uniformity. A live alternative is sequential legal differentiation in which not all forms remain concurrently valid.

changed_reading.before: One God stands behind one generic rite assigned to every community.
changed_reading.after: The one deity can orient genuinely differentiated communal practices; their difference is not itself grounds for mutual seizure or dispute.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus community voices God's designation over a received life and is commanded to surrender; the surah later reverses the direction, with God designating the community as surrenderers and placing it in witness relations. Ritual naming thus becomes identity formation: the namers are themselves named by the posture their act performs.

activation_trace.role: Designation anchors the name voiced by the community over the gift.
Handing over control anchors the posture commanded of the namers.
Designation now moves in reverse, from God onto the community.
The community's given identity embodies the same handing-over posture commanded in the focus.
Presence with witnessing turns the named identity outward into a public relation.

structural_cues: 22:78 says that God named the addressees submitters before placing messenger and community in reciprocal witness positions.
The focus itself places divine naming and the surrender imperative in one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored naming and surrender lexemes plus a later witness relation; I supply the arrow that repeatedly naming the giver performs the identity later given back to the community. A live alternative is lexical coordination without direct ritual causation.

changed_reading.before: People pronounce God's name and separately obey the command to surrender.
changed_reading.after: By naming the giver over the gift, the community rehearses the surrendered identity that God later names onto it and turns into public witness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's community-specific mansak and common divine name acquire a built, public dimension when the same name-remembrance appears across several kinds of worship place whose demolition is restrained. The unity of the named deity does not erase differentiated communal habitats; it gives their name-bearing activity a shared stake in protection.

activation_trace.role: A gathered community anchors the plurality of social bodies that require ritual habitat.
A place and performance of devotion lets the focus rite take institutional space.
A building being brought down supplies the concrete threat to ritual continuity.
A narrow-topped building supplies one distinct architectural worship habitat.
A Christian worship place supplies a second differentiated communal habitat.
Places devoted to prayer widen the protected field beyond one building type.
A place of prostration supplies another embodied site of lowered worship.
Vocal mention supplies the activity shared across the differentiated spaces.
The divine designation supplies the common referent spoken within those spaces.

structural_cues: 22:40 ties restraint of human aggression to the continued existence of several named kinds of worship building.
The stated shared activity in those differentiated buildings is frequent remembrance of God's name, echoing the focus purpose clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies multiple worship architectures, threatened demolition, and shared name-remembrance; I supply the arrow from each community's mansak to a protected ecology of public ritual habitats. A live alternative is that 22:40 argues only for providential restraint, not a direct extension of the focus's appointment formula.

changed_reading.before: Each community's mansak is its own ritual act.
changed_reading.after: A communal mansak can be a public name-bearing habitat whose preservation belongs to a wider ecology of differentiated worship spaces.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The topographic opposition is surprising because the packet never explicitly equates the two constructions. It remains anchored in the focus low-ground branch and in 22:11's unstable worship position, conditional rest, and reversal under trial. Downstream prose should call this a spatial analogy, not a lexical definition of ikhbat.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 20, mukhbitin, read spatially against the precarious worship posture in 22:11.

activation_trace.role: Broad low ground supplies a stable, spacious counter-image to precarious worship.
Lateral deviation from a direction makes the edge-position directionally unstable.
Rest occurring only with benefit supplies a conditional imitation of settledness.
Turning something away from its face supplies the reversal that trial exposes.

changed_reading.after: They occupy durable low ground rather than worshipping from a benefit-dependent edge that can flip its occupant under trial.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The refining mechanism is intentionally branch-distant and cross-domain. It remains anchored in the focus mansak's refined-ingot branch and in 22:37's explicit separation of meat and blood from the taqwa that attains. Downstream prose must present it as a material analogy for ritual discrimination, not as the lexical meaning of mansak.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 4, mansakan, activated through its refined-ingot image by the material contrast in 22:37.

activation_trace.role: A purified metal ingot supplies an assay image in which dross and yield are distinguished.
The sacrificial animal keeps the refining analogy attached to the focus ritual.
Literal flesh supplies one material component rejected as the attaining yield.
Literal blood supplies the second material component rejected as the attaining yield.
Attainment functions like the assay criterion separating failed matter from effective orientation.
Self-protection supplies the refined inward yield that passes the criterion.

changed_reading.before: The ritual sends sacrificed matter toward God.
changed_reading.after: The ritual behaves like an assay: material transmission is exposed as dross, while guarded orientation emerges as the effective refined yield.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it activates secondary mappings of both the animal term and ism. It remains anchored in their adjacency in the focus and is sharpened when the animals are later called ritual signs. Downstream prose must say symbolically marked or attributed and must not imply literal branding or physically unmarked livestock.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Words 6 and 12 place the divine name beside the opaque or unmarked living creature.

activation_trace.role: An undifferentiated condition lacking a distinguishing mark supplies the animal's pre-attribution opacity.
A visible identifying mark supplies the secondary image by which naming clarifies provenance.
Ordinary designation keeps the marking image attached to actual naming.
A perceptible marker and ritual sign turns attribution into publicly readable significance.
The dedicated sacrificial animal keeps the sign mechanism attached to the same livestock sequence.

changed_reading.before: The divine name is pronounced over an animal.
changed_reading.after: Naming symbolically moves a living resource from opaque possession into a publicly legible sign of divine provenance.

strongest_changes: The named animal becomes a circulation point: provision moves toward needy people while taqwa, not matter, is the God-directed yield.
Ikhbat becomes an active heart sequence of recognition, tremor, endurance, worship, spending, and guidance.
One deity governs the orientation of differentiated communal rites without making ritual difference itself a warrant for dispute.
Those who voice God's name and surrender are later named submitters, turning ritual attribution into witnessed communal identity.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made two reversals visible: provision offered upward returns outward as food, and a community that names God is later named by God. The split ism inventory also allowed a contained sign-making reading when set beside the animal's opacity and the later ritual-sign language.
remaining_uncertainties: Mansak continues to carry sacrifice, ritual action, site, and habitual route; no single one exhausts the construction.
The differentiated-rites model remains compatible with sequential legal differentiation rather than simultaneous validation of every form.
The protected-space connection is structurally strong but its exact institutional scope is not fixed by the focus ayah.
The assay and symbolic-marking outliers are analogies activated by branch images, not claims about lexical definition.
